title: Fiordland on a Budget
meta_desc: Explore Fiordland & Milford Sound with your family without breaking the bank. Discover free activities.
intro: Milford Sound is a must-visit destination for any family, with its breathtaking scenery and unique wildlife. However, it can be challenging to plan a trip to Fiordland on a budget. With some planning and research, you can have a fantastic family holiday in Fiordland without breaking the bank. In this guide, we will show you how to visit Fiordland & Milford Sound on a family budget of $280-500 per day.

sections.heading: Daily Costs
sections.body:
A daily budget of $280-500 for a family of four is realistic for a trip to Fiordland. This budget includes accommodation, food, and activities. You can expect to pay around $150-250 per night for a family-friendly motel or holiday park, and $50-100 per day for food and snacks. Activities such as the Milford Sound Nature Cruise and kayaking can cost between $100-200 per person.

To save money, consider self-catering accommodation and cooking your own meals. You can also look for package deals that include accommodation and activities.

sections.heading: Free Activities
sections.body:
There are plenty of free activities to enjoy in Fiordland, including the scenic drive from Te Anau to Milford Sound. The drive itself is a highlight of the trip, with stunning views of the surrounding mountains and valleys. You can also stop at the Mirror Lakes, which offer perfectly still reflections of the surrounding landscape.

The Lake Te Anau waterfront and lakeside walk are also free and offer beautiful views of the lake and surrounding mountains.
list: Lake Te Anau waterfront and lakeside walk

sections.heading: Accommodation Options
sections.body:
There are a range of accommodation options in Fiordland, from budget-friendly holiday parks to luxury lodges. For a family of four, a mid-range motel or holiday park is a good option, with prices starting from around $150-200 per night.

Some popular accommodation options include the Te Anau Top 10 Holiday Resort and the Milford Sound Lodge.
